description: This source file defines the 'Details' feature for user information retrieval in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes a request query, validation, and handler to fetch user details by username, generate a JWT token, and return a user envelope.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents a request to retrieve user details by username, implementing IRequest<UserEnvelope>.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the Query to ensure the Username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query to fetch user data from the database, generate JWT token, and return user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the user details request, querying the database, validating existence, generating token, and returning user info.
